title: Is Your LLM-as-a-Recommender Agent Trustable? LLMs’ Recommendation is Easily Hacked by Biases (Preferences)
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating cognitive and structural biases (such as authority, bandwagon, and position bias) within LLM-based recommendation systems across domains like paper review and e-commerce. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith, or moral/ethical reasoning, and its discussion of ethics is limited to a standard 'Ethical considerations' section.
